## Why This Is Asked

Tests advanced system design: on-device ML with privacy guarantees, explainability, OTA updates, and regulatory considerations. It requires balancing compute, energy, latency, and business value at scale.

## Key Concepts

- On-device inference footprints (memory, CPU, energy)
- Explainability overhead and latency implications
- OTA update strategy and bandwidth budgeting
- Drift detection, validation costs, and governance
- Privacy/compliance costs and risk management
- Break-even analysis and go/no-go criteria

## Code Example

```javascript
function shouldGoLive(costs, benefits) {
  // simplified NPV check for go/no-go decision
  const npv = benefits.discounted - costs.discounted;
  return npv > 0;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you measure explainability latency in production and what targets would you set?
- What drift detectors and validation experiments would you run offline and online?
- How would you audit privacy/compliance across OTA updates and data minimization?

```javascript
}
```

- How would you handle model drift and new fraud patterns locally without cloud updates?

## Why This Is Asked

```javascript
function selectPriority(battery, charging, network) {
  if ((battery < 20) && !charging) return 'Bulk'
  if (network === 'cellular' && battery < 50) return 'Bulk'
  if (battery >= 80 || charging) return 'Critical'
  return 'Important'
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- What would be your go/no-go criteria for the feature?

## Why This Is Asked

- Edge vs central cost modeling
- Data locality and regulatory penalties
- Cadence of content updates and delta-sync strategies
- Break-even analysis and sensitivity

## Code Example

```javascript
function breakEven(cost, monthlySavings, months=24) {
  let total = 0;
  for (let m = 1; m <= months; m++) total += monthlySavings - cost;
  return total;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you quantify regulatory penalties for data locality breaches?
- How would you validate latency improvements with real users and map to ARPU?
